title: U2 release Carnaval de Luz, their first album of new songs in nine years
summary: The 12-track album is out today on Island Records.
body:
U2 have released Carnaval de Luz today, the band's first album of new songs since Songs of Experience in 2017.

The 12-track record was produced by Jacknife Lee and is out on Island Records. Its single "Silencio" was released ahead of the album.

Guests and collaborators

The band worked with a number of collaborators on the album, including Brian Eno, Daniel Lanois, Martin Garrix and Ryan Tedder. It also features a guest vocal from Dolly Parton on the closing track, "Torn".

U2 released two EPs earlier this year, Days of Ash and Easter Lily, which the band has linked to the new album.

Sources: Rolling Stone, Ultimate Classic Rock, NPR.
